text: I'm looking after my niece tonight, she's 6, and I'm really scared. Her temperature is 39.1. She has these little spots and some darker blotchy marks and they're hard to make out on her because her skin is dark, so I looked at the paler bits. There's tiny dots on the palms of her hands, on the bottom of her feet as well, and when I pulled her bottom eyelid down gently there were little red-purple specks inside it. I pressed the side of a glass on the ones on her hand like you see people do and they DIDN'T go away, I could still see them clear as anything through the glass. I did it twice to make sure. Her mum is away and I don't know what to do, I don't want to overreact but I also don't want to sit here if this is something. Please tell me what I should do, do I take her somewhere now?
